strength.talent_text:
New Active Ability: Burrow

The hero quickly burrows into the ground. There, he receives reduced damage and increases his abilities: Spiked Carapace affects all surrounding enemies in a 400 radius, Mind Flare and Impale receive increased cast range, and their cooldown is also reduced.

Reduce Movement Speed ​​in Burrow: 300
Reduce Total Damage Received in Burrow: 3%
Restore Health and Mana in Burrow: 0.5%
Cooldown Reduction in Burrow: 10%
Additional Spell Range: 100
